database.description: Phase 2 (database) — Prisma schema, migration, and seed verification. Tracks the data layer directly; the per-module pub-*/adm-* entries below stay not_started until real UI/API code reads from these tables.

items.feature: Migration applies to a real PostgreSQL database with zero drift
items.notes: PostgreSQL 16 installed locally (Homebrew) since none was available in this environment. Migration SQL generated statically via `prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema=prisma/schema.prisma --script` (prisma/migrations/20260913114324_init_content_modules/), then applied for real with `prisma migrate deploy` — succeeded. `prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema=prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code` confirms zero drift afterward. A second migration (prisma/migrations/20260913121742_add_auth_sessions/) added the Session table and User lockout fields in Phase 3.

items.feature: Seed script populates one demo record per module and is idempotent
items.notes: `npx prisma db seed` run repeatedly against the real database; row counts unchanged on repeat runs (all upserts). Seeds baseline roles, one placeholder college, one [DEV SEED] admin user, one [PLACEHOLDER] demo record per content module, and all 20 ComplianceRequirement rows transcribed from docs/compliance-matrix.md. Phase 4/homepage work found and fixed a real idempotency bug: several upserts' `update` branches were missing fields (status, startDate) that only `create` set, so re-seeding an already-existing row silently never published it or kept its date current — both are now mirrored into `update` too.

Verified via psql that only item #4 is VERIFIED and all other 19 remain NOT_STARTED (CLAUDE.md rule 7). cms_modules.description: CMS modules for College Profile, Departments, Programs, Faculty, Staff, Notices, Events, Seminars, Workshops, Academic Calendar, Timetables, Admissions, Fee Structures, Enrollment Statistics, Examinations, Results, Documents, Infrastructure, Activities, Clubs, Gallery, Scholarships, Student Support, Policies, Regulations, Affiliation, Contact, and Location — the first real admin-side content authoring in the project (everything before this was PagePlaceholder). Each module has list/view/create/edit pages plus the full draft -> pending_review -> approved -> published -> archived workflow, sharing one generic engine (src/lib/content-workflow.ts) and one audit-log writer (src/lib/audit.ts) rather than reimplementing either 28 times. Notices/Events/Seminars/Workshops/Academic Calendar/Timetables/Admissions/Examinations/Results/Affiliation also share src/lib/admin/zod-helpers.ts for date-field validation/conversion. Admissions/Fee Structures/Enrollment Statistics are the first modules in the `content_admissions` domain and Examinations/Results the first in `content_examinations`; Clubs is the third `content_faculty` module (alongside Faculty/Staff). Documents closed the long-tracked Document publish-gate gap; this batch similarly added `publishedAt`/`publishedBy` to `Contact` and `Location`, which (like `FeeStructure`/`EnrollmentStatistic`/`Result` before them) had `status` but not the publish-timestamp columns the shared workflow engine needs. Gallery is the first nested-resource module (GalleryAlbum -> GalleryItem, where adding an item also creates a fresh Media asset in the same action) and Location is the second true singleton module (after College Profile), using `findFirst` rather than `findUnique` since `Location.collegeId` has no `@unique` constraint.

items.feature: Timetables: end-to-end lifecycle exercising a required Program FK, an optional JSON structuredSchedule field (with malformed-JSON rejection on edit), workflow through publish, and public visibility on /academics; also confirms a wrong-domain role (ADMISSION_OFFICER) cannot create one
items.notes: tests/e2e/cms-timetables.spec.ts (6 tests, all passing; verified stable across 3 consecutive full-suite runs). Found and fixed two real e2e bugs while writing this: (1) ambiguous `getByLabel` matchers (e.g. "Program" also matching the sidebar's "Programs" nav link) silently targeted the wrong element — replaced with direct `#id` locators; (2) capturing `page.url()` right after a content-based `expect(...).toBeVisible()` could still read the stale `/new` URL, because during a Next.js client-side transition the new page's DOM can attach a tick before the address bar/history commits — fixed with `page.waitForURL((url) => !url.pathname.endsWith("/new"))` before reading `page.url()`. Also found a distinct bug in the test itself (not the app): logging in as a second role (`loginAs(page, "reviewer")`) on the same page/context right after a prior `loginAs(page, "editor")` call hung, because the app redirects an already-authenticated session away from /login before the login form ever renders — fixed by splitting the editor and reviewer steps into separate `test()` blocks (each gets a fresh context), matching the pattern already used in cms-notices.spec.ts and cms-departments.spec.ts.

items.notes: tests/unit/admin/fee-structures/actions.test.ts. Prisma's Decimal type can't cross the Server Component -> Client Component boundary as-is (it's a class instance, not a plain serializable value) — FeeStructureForm.tsx accepts a pre-serialized `amount: string` and the edit page converts it with `.toString()` before passing it down; found and fixed while building this module, generalizable to any future Decimal-bearing form.

items.feature: Enrollment Statistics create/update/transition: required Program FK, required totalEnrolled, optional maleCount/femaleCount left null (not invented as zero) when blank
items.notes: tests/unit/admin/enrollment-statistics/actions.test.ts. Found a real Zod pitfall while building this: `z.coerce.number().min(0).optional().or(z.literal(""))` silently turns a blank field into 0 rather than falling through to the empty-string branch, because `Number("") === 0` already satisfies `min(0)` before the literal("") alternative is ever tried (unlike the pre-existing establishedYear precedent, whose min(1800) bound reliably fails for a coerced-to-0 blank value) — fixed by passing `formData.get(x) || undefined` into a plain `.optional()` schema instead of routing a literal empty string through the number coercion at all. This is a CLAUDE.md rule 1 correctness fix (never invent data), not just a style choice.

public_website.notes: src/app/(public)/page.tsx + src/components/home/*.tsx — every section reads live, publish-gated content from src/lib/content.ts; each is independently streamed via <Suspense> so a slow query never blocks the rest of the page. Covered by tests/e2e/homepage.spec.ts (11 tests), tests/e2e/public-site.spec.ts, and tests/unit/content/queries.test.ts.

public_website.feature: About (College Profile, History, Vision/Mission, Principal's Message)
public_website.notes: src/app/(public)/about/page.tsx — one CollegeProfile row rendered as 4 labeled sections (consolidates 4 of the original 29 routes into clearly-headed sections on one page, per progress.md's decisions log). Covered by tests/e2e/public-content.spec.ts (breadcrumb check).

src/app/(public)/academics/page.tsx — 4 DataTable sections from Department/Program/AcademicCalendar/Timetable (consolidates 4 of the original routes). Manually verified rendering via a Playwright screenshot at desktop and mobile width; no dedicated e2e assertion beyond that yet.

src/app/(public)/admissions/page.tsx — 3 DataTable sections from Admission/FeeStructure/EnrollmentStatistic. tests/e2e/cms-admissions.spec.ts publishes a real admission cycle through the CMS and confirms it renders on this page by its academic year.
src/app/(public)/faculty/page.tsx — DataTable from Faculty + Department. Covered by tests/e2e/public-content.spec.ts and shell-content-queries.
src/app/(public)/staff/page.tsx — DataTable from Staff. No page-specific e2e assertion yet.

src/app/(public)/campus/page.tsx — Infrastructure DataTable + Location address/map (consolidates 2 of the original routes). tests/e2e/cms-location.spec.ts confirms an edited Location address renders here; Infrastructure itself still has no page-specific e2e assertion beyond the generic no-500 check.
src/app/(public)/notices/page.tsx — Notice list, newest first. Covered by tests/e2e/public-content.spec.ts.

src/app/(public)/events/page.tsx — 5 sections (consolidates Events + the former standalone Activities route plus Seminars/Workshops/Clubs, which had no route of their own before). Admin CMS modules now exist for all 5 underlying models (adm-activities, adm-clubs, plus the earlier adm-seminars/adm-workshops/adm-events), but no page-specific e2e assertion on this page itself yet beyond the generic no-500 check.

src/app/(public)/gallery/page.tsx — GalleryAlbum -> GalleryItem -> Media, each image rendered with required alt text. tests/e2e/cms-gallery.spec.ts publishes a real album+item through the CMS and confirms both render here.

src/app/(public)/examinations/page.tsx — DataTable from Examination + Program. The admin CMS module (adm-exams) can now publish real Examination rows; no page-specific e2e assertion on /examinations itself yet (only the generic no-500 check in public-site.spec.ts and the cms-results.spec.ts fixture examination, which isn't asserted against this page).

src/app/(public)/results/page.tsx — DataTable from Result, gated on status: PUBLISHED AND isPublic: true (rule 4's strictest case: two independent flags both have to allow it). tests/e2e/cms-results.spec.ts directly proves the double gate: a PUBLISHED-but-not-public result is confirmed absent from this page, then confirmed to appear once isPublic is also set.
src/app/(public)/scholarships/page.tsx — card list from Scholarship. Admin CMS module now exists (adm-scholarships); no page-specific e2e assertion yet.
src/app/(public)/student-support/page.tsx — card list from StudentSupport. Admin CMS module now exists (adm-student-support); no page-specific e2e assertion yet.

src/app/(public)/rules/page.tsx — 2 sections (consolidates the former rules-regulations route's scope, now split by underlying model). Admin CMS modules now exist for both (adm-policies, adm-regulations); no page-specific e2e assertion yet.
src/app/(public)/affiliation/page.tsx — DataTable from Affiliation + Program. Admin CMS module now exists (adm-affiliation); no page-specific e2e assertion yet.

src/app/(public)/grievance/page.tsx + actions.ts — real submission form (Server Action) writing to Grievance with submitterContact encrypted at rest (rule 6); no listing of past submissions is ever rendered publicly. Covered by tests/unit/grievance/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/public-content.spec.ts + tests/e2e/homepage.spec.ts (grievance callout link).

src/app/(public)/contact/page.tsx — Contact list + Location address (folds the former standalone Location route's address display in here too; Campus owns the map). Admin CMS module now exists (adm-contact); no page-specific e2e assertion yet.

src/app/(public)/downloads/page.tsx — DataTable from Document. The former known gap (Document had no status/publish field, so every document for the college was listed regardless of publish state) is now closed — see shell-content-queries and adm-documents — but there is still no page-specific e2e assertion on /downloads itself beyond the generic no-500 check in public-site.spec.ts and the homepage's 'Important documents' section heading check.

src/app/(public)/search/page.tsx + searchSite() in src/lib/content.ts — plain GET form (works without JS), searches Notice/Event/Program/Faculty/Scholarship/Policy titles, PUBLISHED only. Covered by tests/unit/content/queries.test.ts + tests/e2e/public-content.spec.ts.

admin_system.notes: Placeholder content, but now behind requireUser()/requirePermission("dashboard:view") (src/app/admin/page.tsx) and shows the signed-in user's identity/roles; module link grid filtered to what the signed-in user can access. No real data yet.
Placeholder content, gated behind requirePermission("content_general:view"). Draft vs. published state separation (CLAUDE.md rule 4) still to be implemented when the real CMS is built.

Placeholder content, gated behind requirePermission("users:manage"). User/Role/Permission/RolePermission/UserRole tables exist and are actively used by the auth system (prisma/schema.prisma); no CRUD UI/API yet.

Placeholder content, gated behind requirePermission("roles:manage"). Role table now seeded with the 8 required roles + full permission matrix (prisma/seed.ts, docs/permission-matrix.md); no CRUD UI/API yet.

Placeholder content, gated behind requirePermission("permissions:manage"). Server-side authorization is now implemented and enforced on every admin route (CLAUDE.md rule 5) — see the `auth` section above for the test suite. No CRUD UI/API for editing the matrix yet; it's defined in code (src/lib/auth/permissions.ts).

Full CMS module: singleton view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/college-profile/). Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/college-profile/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/departments/). Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/departments/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-departments.spec.ts (full cross-role lifecycle e2e).

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/notices/), including publishDate/expiryDate fields. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/notices/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-notices.spec.ts (full cross-role lifecycle e2e, 10 tests).

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/events/), including required startDate and optional endDate/location. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/events/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/seminars/), with an optional Department FK (college-wide when omitted) and speaker field. Not a distinct top-level circular section (folded into the public site's consolidated Events page alongside Workshops/Activities/Clubs — see pub-events), but given its own dedicated admin CMS module. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/seminars/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/workshops/), near-identical to Seminars but with a facilitator field instead of speaker. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/workshops/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/faculty/), including department FK select and subjectsTaught array field. Gated on content_faculty:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/faculty/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-faculty.spec.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/staff/). Gated on content_faculty:* (shares Faculty's domain). Covered by tests/unit/admin/staff/actions.test.ts.
Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/activities/), no FK. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/activities/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/clubs/), with an optional Faculty FK as advisor. Gated on content_faculty:* (the third module in this domain, alongside Faculty/Staff). Covered by tests/unit/admin/clubs/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/infrastructure/), with a required InfrastructureCategory enum select. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/infrastructure/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/programs/), including department FK select and level enum. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/programs/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/admissions/), with a required Program FK. Gated on content_admissions:* (the first module built on this domain). Covered by tests/unit/admin/admissions/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-admissions.spec.ts (full cross-role lifecycle e2e, 6 tests).

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/fee-structures/), with a required Program FK, an optional Admission FK, and a Decimal amount field. Not its own top-level circular section — folds into the public Admissions page's fee-structure table (see pub-admissions) — but given its own dedicated admin CMS module, same as Seminars/Workshops under Events. Gated on content_admissions:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/fee-structures/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/enrollment-statistics/), with a required Program FK and required/optional integer count fields. Folds into the public Admissions page's enrollment-statistics table (see pub-admissions). Gated on content_admissions:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/enrollment-statistics/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/timetables/), with a required Program FK and an optional JSON structuredSchedule field (rejects malformed JSON on both create and edit). Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/timetables/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-timetables.spec.ts (full lifecycle e2e, 6 tests).

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/academic-calendar/), including required startDate/optional endDate and plain category/academicYear fields. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/academic-calendar/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/exams/), with a required Program FK and an optional Notice FK. Gated on content_examinations:* (the first module built on this domain). Covered by tests/unit/admin/exams/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/results/), with required Program + Examination FKs and an isPublic checkbox implementing the double publish gate (see pub-results). Gated on content_examinations:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/results/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-results.spec.ts (full cross-role lifecycle + double-gate e2e, 7 tests).

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/documents/), authoring the general (not-attached-to-another-record) documents shown on the public Downloads page. Gated on content_general:*. Required adding status/publishedAt/publishedBy to the Document model for the first time (prisma/migrations/20260914090529_add_workflow_fields_admissions_documents), closing the shell-content-queries known gap. Covered by tests/unit/admin/documents/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: album list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/gallery/), plus a nested item resource (GalleryAlbum -> GalleryItem) where adding an item also creates a fresh Media asset (accessibility-required alt text, media type) in the same Server Action. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/gallery/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-gallery.spec.ts (full nested-resource lifecycle e2e, 6 tests).

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/scholarships/), no FK. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/scholarships/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/student-support/), no FK. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/student-support/actions.test.ts.
Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/policies/), no FK. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/policies/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/regulations/), no FK. Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/regulations/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/affiliation/), with an optional Program FK (college-wide when omitted). Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/affiliation/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: list/view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/contact/), with a required ContactType enum select. Required adding publishedAt/publishedBy to Contact for the first time (prisma/migrations/20260914093028_add_workflow_fields_contact_location). Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/contact/actions.test.ts.

Full CMS module: singleton view/create/edit + draft/review/publish/archive workflow (src/app/admin/location/), the second true singleton after College Profile — uses findFirst rather than findUnique since Location.collegeId has no @unique constraint. Also required adding publishedAt/publishedBy to Location for the first time (same migration as Contact). Gated on content_general:*. Covered by tests/unit/admin/location/actions.test.ts + tests/e2e/cms-location.spec.ts (singleton-guard + editing-doesn't-revert-status e2e, 4 tests).
